root_claim: Boeing 737-8 and 737-9 may operate in US air commerce after Lion Air 610.
failed_or_unsupported_leaf: Emergency AD 2018-23-51 (2018-11-07): Airplane Flight Manual runaway-stabilizer procedures. Checklist/AFM leaf; passenger-carrying flights continued.
binding_leaf: FAA Emergency Order of Prohibition, 2019-03-13, covering 737-8 and 737-9. Independent investigation plus an order operators must obey.
stop: 737-8/737-9 would not take off in US commerce under the Order until later airworthiness action (including AD 2020-24-02 software/AFM/trim/AOA/readiness-flight conditions) allowed return.

sources.title: FAA Emergency Order of Prohibition (737-8 and 737-9), 2019-03-13
